next:or:208.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:208.fullSentence: He was sitting with a pipe in his mouth.
next:or:208.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+前置詞句。

next:or:209.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:209.hint: 体の状態を表す付帯状況の過去分詞
next:or:209.question: He was sitting [[with his eyes closing]].
next:or:209.fullSentence: He was sitting with his eyes closed.
next:or:209.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+過去分詞。
next:or:209.relatedInfo: 目は「閉じられる」受動関係なのでclosedを使う。

next:or:210.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:210.fullSentence: You should decide with this in mind.
next:or:210.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+前置詞句。決断する際の慣用表現。
next:or:210.relatedInfo: with A in mindで『Aを念頭に置いて』。

next:or:211.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:211.hint: 体の位置関係を表す付帯状況表現
next:or:211.question: He was standing [[with his back on the wall]].
next:or:211.answer: with his back against the wall
next:or:211.fullSentence: He was standing with his back against the wall.
next:or:211.wrongPart: with his back on the wall
next:or:211.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+前置詞句。
next:or:211.relatedInfo: against the wallで『壁に押し当てて』。

next:or:212.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:212.fullSentence: He was standing with a book under his arm.
next:or:212.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+前置詞句。
next:or:212.relatedInfo: under one's armで『脇にかかえて』。

next:or:213.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:213.hint: 体の状態を表す付帯状況の形容詞
next:or:213.question: He was talking [[with his mouth filled]].
next:or:213.fullSentence: He was talking with his mouth full.
next:or:213.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+形容詞。
next:or:213.relatedInfo: 分詞だけでなく形容詞も付帯状況のwith構文に使える。

next:or:214.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:214.fullSentence: He was sitting with snow in his hair.
next:or:214.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+前置詞句。

next:or:215.hint: 2つのものが同程度であることを表す原級比較
next:or:215.question: This bag is [[so heavy as]] that one.
next:or:215.fullSentence: This bag is as heavy as that one.
next:or:215.relatedInfo: notを伴うとA<Bの意味になる。

next:or:216.hint: この本はあの本ほど面白くない
next:or:216.fullSentence: This book is not as interesting as that one.
next:or:216.relatedInfo: notを伴わない原級比較(A=B)との対比。

next:or:217.hint: 数えられない名詞を使った原級比較の否定形
next:or:217.question: He doesn't have [[as many money as]] his brother.
next:or:217.fullSentence: He doesn't have as much money as his brother.
next:or:217.explanation: not as much+原級+as(数えられない名詞のA<B比較)。
next:or:217.relatedInfo: 数えられる名詞ならas many ... asを使う。

next:or:218.hint: できるだけ早く返信してください
next:or:218.fullSentence: Please reply as soon as possible.
next:or:218.explanation: as+原級+as possible ＝ as+原級+as S can『できるだけ〜』。
next:or:218.relatedInfo: as soon as you canとも言い換え可能。

next:or:219.hint: 倍数表現を使った比較
next:or:219.question: This is [[three times more expensive as]] that one.
next:or:219.fullSentence: This is three times as expensive as that one.
next:or:219.explanation: X times as+原級+as B(倍数表現、A>B)。
next:or:219.relatedInfo: twice, half も同じ枠組みで使う。

next:or:220.hint: この箱はあの箱の2倍重い
next:or:220.fullSentence: This box is twice as heavy as that one.
next:or:220.relatedInfo: 三倍以上はX timesを使う。

next:or:221.hint: 半分の程度を表す原級比較
next:or:221.question: This is [[half expensive as]] that one.
next:or:221.fullSentence: This is half as expensive as that one.
next:or:221.explanation: half as+原級+as B『Bの半分ほど〜』。
next:or:221.relatedInfo: twice as ... asの反対の関係。

next:or:222.hint: 彼女は私の2倍の数の本を持っている
next:or:222.fullSentence: She has twice the number of books that I have.
next:or:222.explanation: twice the+名詞+of/that B(名詞を使った倍数表現)。
next:or:222.relatedInfo: twice as many books as I have とも言い換え可能。

next:or:223.hint: AというよりむしろBを表す比較表現
next:or:223.question: He is [[not so much as a scholar]] a writer.
next:or:223.answer: not so much a scholar as
next:or:223.fullSentence: He is not so much a scholar as a writer.
next:or:223.wrongPart: not so much as a scholar
next:or:223.explanation: not so much A as B『AというよりむしろB』。＝B rather than A。
next:or:223.relatedInfo: A、Bの位置に注意(否定されるのがA)。

next:or:224.hint: 彼は私に挨拶さえしなかった
next:or:224.fullSentence: He didn't so much as say hello to me.
next:or:224.explanation: not so much as doing『〜さえしない』。
next:or:224.relatedInfo: notを伴わずwithoutと組み合わせても使える(without so much as doing)。

next:or:225.hint: 『〜さえせずに』を表す慣用表現
next:or:225.question: He left [[without so much saying]] goodbye.
next:or:225.fullSentence: He left without so much as saying goodbye.
next:or:225.explanation: without so much as doing『〜さえせずに』。
next:or:225.relatedInfo: not so much as doingのwithout版。

next:or:226.hint: このバッグは私が持っているどれにも劣らず良い
next:or:226.fullSentence: This bag is as good as any I have.
next:or:226.explanation: as+原級+as any(最上級的な意味を持つ原級表現)。
next:or:226.relatedInfo: 『どのバッグにも劣らず』という最上級のニュアンス。

next:or:227.hint: 最上級的な意味を持つas...as ever構文
next:or:227.question: He was [[as a brave man as ever lived]].
next:or:227.answer: as brave a man as ever lived
next:or:227.fullSentence: He was as brave a man as ever lived.
next:or:227.wrongPart: as a brave man as ever lived
next:or:227.explanation: as+原級+as ever lived(最上級的表現)。
next:or:227.relatedInfo: a+形容詞+名詞の語順(as brave a man)に注意。

next:or:228.hint: この本はあの本ほど面白くない(比較級の否定)
next:or:228.fullSentence: This book is not more interesting than that one.
next:or:228.explanation: 比較級の否定(not+比較級+than)でA≦Bを表す。
next:or:228.relatedInfo: not as interesting as とほぼ同じ意味になる。

next:or:229.question: Tom is [[very taller]] than John.
next:or:229.fullSentence: Tom is much taller than John.
next:or:229.explanation: 比較級の強調はmuch, far, still, even, by far, a lot, lots, a great dealを使う(veryは不可)。
next:or:229.relatedInfo: veryは原級を強調する語であり比較級には使えない。

next:or:230.hint: 彼は年をとればとるほど、確信を持つようになる
next:or:230.fullSentence: The older he grows, the more certain he becomes.
next:or:230.explanation: The+比較級SV, the+比較級SV『〜すればするほど…』。
next:or:230.relatedInfo: 2つの比較級が対応する構文。

next:or:231.hint: 理由があるからこそ余計に、を表す比較級表現
next:or:231.question: She loves him [[all the more than]] his character.
next:or:231.fullSentence: She loves him all the more for his character.
next:or:231.explanation: all the+比較級+for A『Aだから余計に〜』。
next:or:231.relatedInfo: none the+比較級+for(逆に否定的な文脈)との対比。

next:or:232.hint: 良い規則は繰り返し言われたからといって悪くなるわけではない
next:or:232.fullSentence: A good rule is none the worse for being repeated.
next:or:232.explanation: none the+比較級+for A『Aだからといって少しも〜でない』。
next:or:232.relatedInfo: all the+比較級+for(肯定的な文脈)との対比。
